body: Watchdog rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-23 03:03Z), from Opus3's w-80e0cb2002da diagnosis. A session that shows queuePaused=true and pending>0, or a send that returns heldBehindPausedQueue or durableButNotWoken, right after the session's turn ended is usually an AUTOMATIC Engram retry hold, not a Stop. The orchestrator_auto_dispatch_blocked latch is set while an admission, begin-preparation, abort or bind retry is due, with causes such as begin_preparation_pending, control_unavailable or dispatch_budget_exhausted. These holds self-recover in about 11-19 s, and the API currently projects them as a plain pause. Do NOT resume at once. Resume only if the session is still paused with pending work at least 60 s after first being seen, and its latest dispatch record shows no scheduled automatic retry. The fix (a distinct "waitingForAutomaticRetry" disposition) is w-80e0 (Opus3).
